laws.rule: Toubkal National Park core zone rules: camping prohibited and bivouac regulated; fires only in barbecue areas; fishing, graffiti and carving prohibited; flying below 1,000 metres prohibited. A mountain guide is recommended (not stated as compulsory); the Imlil guides' office can advise.
laws.heading: Réglementation en zone centrale

sources.title: Guide du Parc National de Toubkal
sources.authority: Al Haouz Provincial Tourism Council (Visit Al Haouz)

local-law.note: Toubkal only. Reports that guides are compulsory on the Imlil route come from non-official sites and are not recorded.
